verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says it can sync with Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark and more, and that it provides webhooks for custom workflows. Together these show first-party chat-tool integration covering all three named platforms. missing for 10: explicit documentation that repository and pull request events trigger these chat notifications, configuration details for event selection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send repository and pull request notifications to chat tools like Slack, Discord, or Microsoft Teams

citations.quote: Sync seamlessly with tools like Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark, and more.
Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
